leaves.name: panPrintedB
leaves.doc: R12. Pan, J. Amer. Math. Soc. 35 (2022), 1031-1169, Theorem 1.0.4 (= arXiv:1901.07166v2 Thm 1.0.4 with Conj. 1.0.1, pp. 5 and 2; JAMS number and page UNVERIFIED), p >= 5, for each iota_p : Qbar_p = C, printed form for one rho: rho irreducible (Burnside form), unramified outside finitely many primes, odd, rho|G_Qp potentially semistable (Fontaine admissibility over Berger's B_st = B_max[log p~] inside B_dR, computed on the underlying space V) and Hodge-Tate with distinct weights (on V) => tr rho(Frob_q^geom) = psi(Frob_q^geom) iota_p^-1(a_q(g)) for almost all q, g a normalized cuspidal eigenform
leaves.flag: unread: JAMS theorem number and page locator UNVERIFIED (arXiv v2 statement read, h-a011 section 1.1); eigenform reading: 'comes from a cuspidal eigenform up to twist' read as rho = rho_{g,iota_p} (x) psi', whose trace identity at geometric Frobenius holds in every normalization of rho_g (as for pb-fix2's panPrintedU, whose conclusion this leaf repeats verbatim); pst: dim over B_st^{G_K} of (B_st (x) V)^{G_K} = dim V with B_st = B_max[log p~] inside B_dR (bst-construct); irreducible stated in Burnside form (stronger hypothesis)

Soc. 35 (2022), 1031-1169, Thm 1.0.4 (= arXiv:1901.07166v2 Thm 1.0.4, p. 5; JAMS numbering UNVERIFIED); p >= 5; predicates in Contrib/OneProof/BergerBst.lean (LocalIsPstB) and PanBergerPrinted.lean (LocalDistinctHTU)

leaves.name: bergerPrintedB
leaves.doc: R11. Berger, Invent. Math. 148 (2002), Theoreme 0.7 = Cor. 5.22 of the published version (author copy pp. 6, 52) = Thm 0.6 = Thm 5.19 of arXiv:math/0102179v3, K = Q_p: de Rham => potentially semistable for the Q_p-representation V = E^n underlying rho: dim_Qp (B_dR (x) V)^{G_Qp} = dim V => exists finite K, dim over B_st^{G_K} of (B_st (x) V)^{G_K} = dim V, with Berger's B_st = B_max[log p~] inside Mathlib's B_dR, B_max = A_max[1/p][1/t], A_max = {sum a_n (omega/p)^n : a_n in A_inf -> 0}
